scripts.db:dev:up: docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/compose.yaml --profile dev up -d --wait mysql-dev
scripts.db:dev:down: docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/compose.yaml --profile dev stop mysql-dev
scripts.db:test:up: docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/compose.yaml --profile test up -d --wait mysql-test
scripts.db:test:down: docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/compose.yaml --profile test stop mysql-test
scripts.db:migrate: uv run --project apps/api --locked --cache-dir .uv-cache alembic -c apps/api/alembic.ini upgrade head
scripts.lint:api: uv run --project apps/api --locked --cache-dir .uv-cache ruff check apps/api
scripts.format: prettier --write apps packages infra .github package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml eslint.config.js prettier.config.js README.md
scripts.format:check: prettier --check apps packages infra .github package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml eslint.config.js prettier.config.js README.md
scripts.format:api: uv run --project apps/api --locked --cache-dir .uv-cache ruff format apps/api
scripts.format:api:check: uv run --project apps/api --locked --cache-dir .uv-cache ruff format --check apps/api
scripts.check:web: pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test:unit && pnpm build
scripts.check:api: pnpm lint:api && pnpm format:api:check && pnpm typecheck:api && pnpm test:api
